title: blessed/render-manifest/v1
description: Exactly what a render produced: which bundle it came from, which paths it wrote, and the size and digest of each. Like the admitted bundle, this is NOT a credential — apply never trusts it. Apply re-verifies the bundle, INDEPENDENTLY RE-RENDERS into temporary space, and compares both this manifest and every output byte before touching the repository. That is what makes a hand-edited rendered file uncommittable: the bytes on disk must equal bytes apply derived itself from verified inputs. The output list is closed, so an extra file cannot ride along.
